Maria Chen: Quick ops check for Thu's 'Inference at Scale' webinar — registration page live, Zoom set, recording & lead routing done?
Samir Patel: Registration landing up at https://go.redwood.ai/inference-scale — HubSpot form attached, auto-tag = webinar_inference_2026. Did email confirmation + calendar invite.
Jules Nguyen: Zoom meeting created: https://redwood.zoom.us/meeting/987654321 — set cloud recording + alternative hosts = @Samir Patel, @Ava Lopez. Waiting on passcode decision.
Ava Lopez: Suggest no passcode, waiting room on, restrict screen share to hosts. Also need panelist join link for speakers.
Samir Patel: Agreed. Zoom settings I changed:
```
Cloud Recording: ON (shared link)
Waiting Room: ON
Passcode: OFF
Alternative Hosts: samir@redwood.ai, ava@redwood.ai
Auto-recording: Cloud
```
Maria Chen: Speaker confirmations?
Jules Nguyen: Confirmed: Dr. Lee (ML infra), Kara (Platform), Ben (Customer). I'll DM speaker join links + rehearsal at 10:30 PT.
MarketingBot: Reminder set: rehearsal 10:30 PT Thu for hosts/speakers. RSVP count: 248
Ava Lopez: Post-event follow-up plan: 1) Recording email + link 2) On-demand landing + slides 3) Nurture workflow in HubSpot — tagging & lead score + assign AE queue 'webinar_inference'
Maria Chen: Samir, can you wire recording to S3 + update knowledge base? Also record transcript via otter.ai and attach.
Samir Patel: Yes — will enable Zoom cloud auto-upload to S3 bucket `redwood-webinars/2026-03-inference-scale`. OTTER integration enabled; transcript will be in MeetNotes.
ZoomBot: Cloud recording completed, file: https://zoom.us/rec/share/AbcDefG (access: internal only). Transcript generated: https://zoom.us/transcript/AbcDefG
Ava Lopez: Draft follow-up email subject lines:
- "Thanks for joining: Inference at Scale — recording + slides"
- "Missed it? Watch the Inference at Scale recording"
Maria Chen: Also we should include benchmark one-pager link and the form for gated download. Link: https://go.redwood.ai/benchmarks-2026
Jules Nguyen: Lead routing rules: if lead_score >= 70 -> assign to AE team alpha, else nurture sequence; enterprise leads flagged for CS outreach. HubSpot workflow name: webinar_inference_2026_routing
Samir Patel: I'll export registrants now and set up GA event for 'webinar_register' and 'webinar_watch'
Maria Chen: Great. Post-event tasks assigned: Samir (recording/upload + analytics), Jules (slides + speaker assets), Ava (email copy + HubSpot flow), Maria (press blurbs + benchmarks gating). Any blockers?
Support: Noted: support@redwood.ai will monitor chat during live — cover questions backlog
Maria Chen: Awesome, :white_check_mark: closing thread. If anything urgent ping #oncall-marketing or @here.
